comment: One entry per migration in audit_store.MIGRATIONS (tests/test_migration_rollback_safety.py keeps them in step). rollback_safe: the PREVIOUS release's code still works on a database at this schema, so a code-only rollback is safe. A migration that drops or renames something older code reads is false: then restoring the pre-upgrade archive copy is the only way back, and the confirmation screen says so. description: one plain-language line shown on the Updates page's confirmation (what the migration does).

1.description: Creates the unified archive schema (environments, schedules, banner, events, sync state)
